name: ESP8266 NodeMCU V3
description: Connected IoT microcontroller board running at 80/160MHz with full TCP/IP stack and onboard USB-to-Serial converter.
realWorldAnalogy: Connected IoT microcontroller board running at 80/160MHz with full TCP/IP stack and onboard USB-to-Serial converter.

hazards: GPIO pins accept maximum 3.3V logic levels

wiringGuidance: Use Micro-USB to flash code. Remember that D-number pin labels on the PCB do not match raw GPIO numbers (e.g., D1 is GPIO5, D2 is GPIO4).
commonMistakes: Using D3 or D4 as active low inputs during boot, preventing the ESP8266 from booting into run mode.
Setting Serial Monitor baud rate to 9600 instead of 115200.

miniExperiment.title: NodeMCU Blue LED Pulse
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The blue onboard Wi-Fi module LED flashes a quick beacon flash every second.
